kinepolis_outside_1.notes: Looking east along the facade: the building, bollard row, road, verge trees and Decathlon line up; the near left corner is a few pixels off (Street View stitching close to the camera). The trees are a stock model tinted toward the real yellow-green; the car park has no cars.

kinepolis_outside_2.notes: The facade, sign, star, entrance bays, poles and bollards sit on the photo within a few pixels; the glazing now reflects sky and street. The facade is flush here as in the photo (the plan's 0.4 m step at x 22.7 is left out).

kinepolis_outside_3.notes: Straight-on view: bays, doors, sign, banners, bollards and even the shadows match. The paving reads slightly lighter and pinker than the photo, and the upper glazing reflects a different sky. Plan vs photos: the facade's east-west position is anchored to the grand stair (the entrance bays face it: the first bay's west edge at the stair's west edge, x -2.4). The two bins left of the entrance are moved about 1-1.5 m east of where photo 3 has them, to keep the walk's open doorway clear. For the fly-through, two grey bollards west of the entrance stand further apart and a small black bollard moved 2.3 m west.
